# SentiStrength English word lists

The SentiStrength English data folder, October 2019 release (Thelwall et al., 2010). The extension ships these lists packed in `chrome_extension/sentistrength_data.js`; rebuild it with `node tools/build_ss_data.js`.

SentiStrength and its word lists are free for academic, non-commercial use only. See http://sentistrength.wlv.ac.uk/ for the licence terms.

Note: `backend/py4j/en/` holds a different version of the lists (its `SentimentLookupTable.txt` differs).
